advisor.title: Find your business plan
advisor.subtitle: A few quick questions — then one clear monthly price.
advisor.privacy: Anonymous until checkout. Please don't type ID or phone numbers here.
advisor.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

quote.title: Your recommended plan
quote.aiNote: Explained by AI from your plan's facts
quote.needsBase: Needs an internet connection in your plan
quote.cascadeTitle: This change needs one more step
quote.keep: Keep my plan as it was
quote.expired: This price has expired. Get today's price to continue.
quote.notFound: We couldn't find this plan. Please start again.

otp.title: Confirm your mobile number
otp.intro: We'll send a 6-digit code. Your number links your order to you.
otp.wrongCode: That code is wrong. {left} tries left.
otp.locked: Too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
otp.expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new code.
otp.tooMany: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes.

consent.title: Your data, your choice
consent.intro: Before we check your business documents, here is what we use, why, and for how long. Each choice is separate, and you can change your mind at any time.

NEEDS_ASSESSMENT.title: Plan recommendation
NEEDS_ASSESSMENT.body: Use your business type, city, team size and needs to suggest and price a plan.

KYC_VERIFICATION.title: Business verification (KYC)
KYC_VERIFICATION.body: Read your GST, Udyam, ID and address documents and check them against government registries, as the law requires before connecting a business line.

MARKETING.title: Offers and updates
MARKETING.body: Occasional messages about new services. Off unless you turn it on.

consent.processors: Accel Business. Our AI helper (Groq, outside India) only sees your chat with ID and phone numbers removed — never your documents.
consent.retention: Document images are deleted 7 days after your service starts, or 7 days after you cancel or withdraw consent. Verified details are kept only as long as the law requires.
consent.rights: You can see, correct or erase your data and withdraw consent at any time. Grievance officer: privacy@accel.example
consent.needRequired: Both “Needed to buy” items are required to continue. You can still save your choices.
consent.outdated: This notice was updated. Please review it again.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.kycNext: Next: verify your business documents. You pay after verification.
checkout.paymentFailed: The payment didn't go through and you weren't charged. Please try again.
checkout.paid: Payment received. We'll schedule your installation and keep you updated.
checkout.stale: Something changed since this price was made. Please review your updated plan.
checkout.tampered: This quote can't be used. Please review your plan again.
checkout.kycRequired: Please finish document verification before paying.
checkout.consentRequired: Please accept the required consents first.

track.title: Track your order
track.noOrders: No orders on this number yet.
track.signIn: Confirm your number to see your orders
track.notFound: We couldn't find this order on your number.
track.etaEstimated: Expected around {date} — the clock starts once your documents are verified
track.slaBreached: This is taking longer than it should. Our team has been alerted and will call you.
track.handedOff: A partner will call you to help with your documents.
track.alternative: {name} works at your site: {from}–{to} a month, installed in about {days} days.
track.alternativeDrops: These need a fixed line and would be removed: {items}.
track.refund: Refund of {amount} started. It reaches your account in 5–7 working days.
track.noContact: We couldn't message you, so updates appear here.
track.demoNote: Demo only — operations do this in real life.

next.KYC: Next: verify your business documents. You pay after verification.
next.FIX_KYC: One of your documents needs a fix:
next.PAY: Your documents are verified. Complete payment to book the installation.
next.RETRY_PAYMENT: Your last payment didn't go through and you weren't charged. You can try again.
next.CHOOSE_ALTERNATIVE: Fibre can't reach your site, but there is a wireless option.
next.NONE: Nothing to do for now — we'll message you at every step.

kyc.title: Verify your business
kyc.signIn: Confirm your number to upload documents
kyc.onRecordIntro: Tell us what your documents should show. We check each document against these details and the government registries.
kyc.contactName: Name of the person signing (as on ID)
kyc.privacy: Your documents are encrypted and only read on our servers — never by the AI helper. Images are deleted 7 days after your service starts.
kyc.tooLarge: This file is over 5 MB. Please take a smaller photo.
kyc.wrongType: Please upload a photo (JPG or PNG) or a PDF.
kyc.lookup: Verify my Udyam number from the registry instead

hints.GST_CERTIFICATE: GST REG-06, all pages in one photo or PDF
hints.SIGNATORY_ID: PAN, Aadhaar, passport or voter ID — must not be expired
hints.ADDRESS_PROOF: Electricity or phone bill for the business address, not older than 90 days

status.PASS: All documents verified. You can pay now.
status.REVIEW: A member of our team will check your documents within one working day.
status.PENDING: The government registry isn't responding. Please try again in a few minutes.
